images.title: Four things every pitch needs
images.alt: Four parts of an affiliate pitch email: who you are, the page the product would go on, honest numbers, and one specific ask.
images.caption: Keep the whole email short enough to read on a phone.

items.title: Who you are
items.text: Your site, its topic and who reads it.

items.title: The page
items.text: A live article where the product belongs, with its URL.

items.title: Honest numbers
items.text: What your analytics show. No rounding up, no best month.

items.title: One specific ask
items.text: A higher rate, a reader discount code or a longer cookie. Pick one.

images.title: When a brand goes quiet
images.alt: Steps after an unanswered affiliate pitch: wait about a week, send one short follow-up, log it in a sheet, move on, and retry later.
images.caption: Silence usually has more to do with timing and budgets than with your email.

items.title: Wait a week or so
items.text: Give the first email time before you nudge.

items.title: Follow up once
items.text: Two lines on the same thread: checking it arrived, and the offer stands.

items.title: Log it
items.text: Keep a sheet with brand, contact, date sent and outcome.

items.title: Move on
items.text: Work several prospects at once so no single reply matters too much.

items.title: Try again later
items.text: Pitch again once you've published more in their category.
